data.env:
# Paperless-ngx connection
PAPERLESS_API_URL=http://paperless.local:8000
PAPERLESS_API_TOKEN=stored-paperless-token
PAPERLESS_USERNAME=archivist
PAPERLESS_PROBE_INTERVAL_SECONDS=30

# Document processing
DISABLE_AUTOMATIC_PROCESSING=yes
TAGS=a,b

# AI provider
AI_PROVIDER=openai
OPENAI_API_KEY=stored-openai-key
OPENAI_MODEL=gpt-4o-mini
OLLAMA_MODEL=llama3.1:8b

# AI behaviour
SYSTEM_PROMPT="You are \"careful\" # always"

# OCR fallback
OCR_AUTO_PROCESS_ENABLED=no

# Server and security
API_KEY=test-api-key
EXPOSE_API_DOCS=yes
CONFIG_SOURCE_MODE=runtime-first

# Single sign-on (OIDC)
OIDC_ENABLED=yes
OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET="secret with space"

# Maintenance
LOG_LEVEL=error
RECONCILIATION_ENABLED=no
ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY=no

# Interface
DATE_FORMAT=YYYY-MM-DD
